description: A shell script for testing 'git send-email' functionality, including setup of test environment, mock tools, patch extraction, and various test cases for email sending features.

methods.name: replace_variable_fields
methods.description: Replaces date, message ID, and X-Mailer fields in email headers with placeholders.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_no_confirm
methods.description: Performs a test to ensure no confirmation prompt occurs.

methods.name: check_no_confirm
methods.description: Checks if no-confirm test failed and sets a prerequisite flag.

methods.name: test_suppress_self
methods.description: Tests suppression of self in email CC list.

methods.name: test_suppress_self_unquoted
methods.description: Tests suppression of self with unquoted name.

methods.name: test_suppress_self_quoted
methods.description: Tests suppression of self with quoted name.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified author and message.

methods.name: test_suppression
methods.description: Tests various suppression options for CC.

methods.name: test_confirm
methods.description: Tests confirmation prompts with different options.
